annotations.text:
HOME — with Eli's real copy and the palette
White base, nude #CBC1B4 and black #1E1A19 for surfaces, red #7F0F1D for every action and highlight, deep wine #4D1418 for the philosophy block, brown #7C6860 for secondary text.

Two typefaces: a bold grotesque for headlines and an italic serif for the one word that matters (limits. / live better. / together?). The energy stays in the scale, the marquee and the red; the tone is more mature to match the palette.

COACHING, ABOUT, CONTACT — all with Eli's real copy and photos.
Contact: the email button opens the mail app without showing the address (anti-spam). Instagram links to @elideltorov. No TikTok.
Domain: elideltoro.com. Build: Astro static site on Cloudflare Pages.
